title: Sprig user configuration
description: Private TOML, schema version 1. Cross-field, endpoint, path and permission restrictions are additionally checked at runtime.

command.description: Trusted TUI editor argv; empty disables. Optional standalone {file}, otherwise append private draft path. No shell or environment expansion.

recover_output_limit.description: Allow one fresh request after an output-token limit, within max_steps. Trusted user or profile setting.

recover_context_budget.description: Offer one approved summary request when an active task exceeds the local context budget and can still continue within max_steps. Trusted user or profile setting.

extra_body.description: Provider-specific JSON fields; <=16 KiB, depth <=12. Reserved request/security fields are rejected.

exclude.description: Relative POSIX glob patterns; no !, .. components, backslashes or absolute paths. Adds to .sprigignore.

output_limit.description: Raw command output kill limit; defaults to 1 MiB. 0 restores stopping at max_output. Higher values use bounded redacted head/tail display.

files.description: Initial workspace-relative POSIX file references; <=8 KiB total paths. Runtime selections are saved separately. Small complete snapshots refresh before requests; larger files attach path/size only.
Required workspace-relative UTF-8 files; no globs. Existing privacy and instruction limits apply.

dirs.description: Explicit skill collection directories, relative to the declaring user/profile config. Project settings cannot add roots. No automatic home/workspace scan.

enabled.description: Opt-in public HTTP(S) documents. Each GET needs approval; no proxies, auth, redirects, retries or persistent cache. Project configuration cannot enable it.

template.description: Literal task text, at most 16 KiB UTF-8. $ARGUMENTS or contiguous $1..$9, $$ for a literal dollar. No shell, file or environment interpolation.

prompts.description: Trusted user/profile prompt library, at most 48 KiB UTF-8 total; project settings cannot define prompts.

proxy.description: system, direct, or an HTTP(S) proxy URL without credentials.

extra_body.description: Provider-specific JSON fields; <=16 KiB, depth <=12. Reserved request/security fields are rejected.
